title: Entangled quantum clocks as operational probes of spacetime curvature
summary: Building on the framework developed by Perche [Phys. Rev. D 106, 025018 (2022)], we study two localized nonrelativistic quantum particles propagating along timelike geodesics in a curved spacetime background. Each particle is coupled to a quantum clock that operationally records the time spent in a prescribed spatial region. We compute the covariance of the resulting time observables for separable and entangled two-particle states, comparing flat and curved backgrounds.
